title: Humanoid Robotics Oversight and Blocking of Obtainment from Totalitarians Act of 2025 (Humanoid ROBOT Act of 2025)
sponsor: Sen. Bill Cassidy (introduced for himself and Sen. Chris Coons)
committee: Senate Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs
status: S. 3275: 2025-11-20 — Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
summary: Bars executive agency procurement or use by federal contractors of humanoid robots designed, tested, developed, or manufactured by covered entities, with a Defense Secretary waiver for national-security or research objectives. Directs CFIUS to review certain investments in humanoid-robot production. Directs the Defense Secretary to report within a year on national-security threats, including privacy/data security, supply-side development and export-control or IP concerns.
mechanism_scope_limitations: Procurement/contractor prohibitions apply 180 days after enactment; the waiver is assigned to the Secretary of Defense. The CFIUS review and DoD report concern countries/entities defined in the bill; this is a federal procurement, investment-review, and reporting framework rather than a general civilian use prohibition.

quotes.quote: A person awarded a contract by an executive agency may not use a humanoid robot designed, tested, developed, or manufactured by a covered entity to fulfill, execute, or otherwise support carrying out the contract.

latest_actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
